assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
This diagnostic monitoring service was medically necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms of palpitations, dizziness, and giddiness with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is the service in question.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
SilverBridge Advantage requires all such diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
A formal appeal should be submitted within the designated timeframe, including any supporting clinical documentation that justifies the medical necessity of the service.
Failure to provide adequate justification may result in the finalization of this denial.
